Faq
What is a tracked user? A tracked user is someone who has given feedback. This can be via creating a post or voting/commenting on a post. Those actions can be taken by the user themselves, by an admin on their behalf, or by Autopilot.
How many tracked users do I need? Fewer than you think. Most teams new to Canny find the Free plan’s 25 tracked users enough to start uncovering impactful feedback. Many teams use Canny for months before needing to upgrade to a paid plan.
For a B2B SaaS company, typically around 1-5% of total users become tracked users. This will vary based on how proactive you are at collecting feedback.
Running a high-volume B2C/consumer product? Reach out-we offer custom tracked user limits for larger scale feedback programs.
Can I set a monthly spend limit? Yes, you’re always in control. You can set a monthly spend limit, and we’ll pause upgrades once you hit it. We’ll notify you when you hit your limit.
Once your limit is hit, Canny will stop tracking feedback from new users. You can update or remove your limit anytime.
What happens if I go over my tracked user limit? If you haven’t set a monthly spend limit, we’ll automatically upgrade you to the next tier once you exceed your limit. You’ll be charged a prorated amount for the remainder of your billing period.
If you’ve set a spend limit, we’ll stop tracking feedback from new users once you reach it—no surprises.
What is Canny Autopilot? Autopilot refers to Canny's suite of AI-powered features:
Feedback Discovery: automatically captures feedback. It finds feedback in customer chats, sales calls, customer reviews, and more. Any detected duplicates are merged together. Users with feedback found by Autopilot count towards your tracked user count.
Smart Replies: Autopilot will automatically reply to Canny posts to collect more details.
Comment Summaries: instantly summarize comments to reveal the main themes.

Amy-Lynn Taylor
Product Enablement & Insights, Jane App
Frequently asked questions
Which AI tools does the Canny MCP server work with? ChatGPT, Claude, and Cursor today, plus other MCP-compatible clients.
Can it change my feedback, or only read it? Both. It can read your feedback and make changes, scoped to your permissions and logged with undo.
Is my data secure? Yes. Setup uses OAuth, access is limited to your existing Canny permissions, and every action is recorded in an audit log.
What can I ask it to do? Canny exposes over 55 tools through MCP. Send conversations to Autopilot, query feedback, themes, roadmap, and revenue context. Then organize feedback, update statuses, link deals, and reply to customers.
What plan do I need? The MCP server is available on any paid plan.
How long does setup take? A couple of minutes. Add the server to your AI tool and sign in, with no engineering.

Know who's behind every request
Every request comes tied to the customer, account, and revenue behind it. Open the original conversation anytime for the full story.
Keep every request organized automatically
Merge duplicates and automatically organize feedback by product area. Autopilot learns about your product so it knows where everything belongs. No weekly triage or backlog cleanup.
Stop missing feedback in customer conversations
“ We are using Autopilot to route feedback into groups, and just that piece alone has been a massive time saver. ” See how Jane App automates feedback with Autopilot
Amy-Lynn Taylor
Product Enablement & Insights, Jane App
Understand what customers really want
Autopilot surfaces the context behind requests, not just the ask. Get a sense of how urgent requests are to specific customers. Spot themes across your feedback to see what matters most.
How teams use Autopilot
Don't take our word for it. Teams like yours save time and understand their customers better with Autopilot.
“ Canny's Autopilot ensures feature requests never fall through the cracks. We've seen an 80% increase in requests logged since introducing Autopilot. ” Owen Doherty COO, Orca Scan “ I LOVE how it auto-scans our support tickets and magically finds feedback. We've been able to 10x our feedback & remove many duplicate posts. ” Keenan Jones VP Product, Credit Repair Cloud “ We're seeing hundreds of support tickets turned into actionable insights both unique and as votes on existing posts with very high accuracy. ” Matt Cromwell Senior Director, CX, Stellar WP
Frequently asked questions
What sources can Autopilot capture feedback from? Autopilot captures feedback from your support and conversation tools, including Gong, Intercom, Slack, Zendesk, Help Scout, Freshdesk, Zoom, and tl;dv. It also reads public reviews from sites like G2, Capterra, Trustpilot, the App Store, and Google Play, and connects to hundreds more tools through Zapier.
How accurate is Autopilot? Very. In one customer’s audit of 1,725 support tickets, Autopilot identified feature requests with 93% accuracy, catching 30% more than their team did manually. It also caught requests the team had missed entirely.
Can I review and undo what Autopilot does? Yes. Autopilot works automatically, and a full audit log shows everything it captured, merged, and organized. If it gets something wrong, you can undo any action.
Does Autopilot post feedback publicly? Not by default. Autopilot captures feedback into your internal workspace, where only your team can see it. Sharing anything publicly through Portal is a separate, optional step you control. Alternatively, you can control this behavior per source.
Does Canny offer other AI tools? Yes. Beyond capturing feedback, Autopilot powers Smart Replies, which asks customers follow-up questions automatically, and Comment Summaries, which condense long threads. You can learn more on the Portal and Collect Feedback pages.
Is my data secure? Yes. We don't use your data to train our models. Autopilot also runs on the same security standards as the rest of Canny, including SOC 2 Type 2 compliance.
